supersedes: 1.0.0 -- owner_model was gpt-5 and every model sent temperature
_read_me: Model ids live HERE and nowhere else in the source. A model id scattered
across four modules is four places to miss when one of them changes, and a
silent model change invalidates every comparison made across it.
`params` is the NEW part and it is the reason 1.0.0 would have failed on
its first live call. Current flagship reasoning models REJECT sampling
parameters outright -- they do not ignore them -- so a hard-coded
`temperature: 0` in the transport is a 400 on every request. Which
parameters a model accepts is now DATA here rather than a branch in
providers.py, so a provider that changes its surface is a diff in this
file and not a rewrite of the transport.
A change to this file is a reviewable diff on a protected path. The
orchestrator records the resolved model id in every run's metadata.json,
so a past run is read back against the model that actually produced it
rather than against whatever this file says today.

verified_2026_09_23: gpt-5.6-sol is the current OpenAI flagship; GA 2026-07-09; the gpt-5.6
alias routes to it. 1,050,000 token context, up to 128,000 completion
tokens. Supports tools, tool_choice and JSON-schema structured outputs.
Served on BOTH chat/completions and the Responses API.
PARAMETERS: takes max_completion_tokens, NOT max_tokens. REJECTS
temperature with HTTP 400 'Unsupported value: temperature does not
support 0 with this model. Only the default (1) value is supported.'
-- reasoning models disable sampling controls categorically.
claude-opus-5 is current on the Messages API and the exact id string --
no date suffix. 1M context, 128K max output, $5/$25 per MTok.
PARAMETERS: max_tokens is correct and required. temperature, top_p and
top_k were REMOVED on this model and return a 400; thinking is adaptive
and ON by default when the thinking parameter is omitted, which is what
this runtime does. Endpoint /v1/messages with anthropic-version
2023-06-01 is unchanged.
sonar-pro is current in Perplexity's Sonar family -- the Search tier's
deeper-retrieval model, roughly double sonar's citations per search.
Chat-completions shaped and NOT a reasoning model, so it still takes
max_tokens and temperature; temperature 0 is kept here deliberately
because run-to-run variation buys nothing in an evidence-gathering
worker. Availability on a specific account is NOT verifiable from this
checkout and is a one-time owner check.

endpoint_choice_note: OpenAI stays on chat/completions rather than moving to the Responses API.
gpt-5.6-sol is served on both. The Responses API earns its extra surface
when a caller needs server-side conversation state, reasoning items
carried between turns, or built-in hosted tools. This runtime needs none
of those: one system prompt, one user prompt, one JSON object back, and
every piece of state it cares about lives in the repository by design.
Migrating would add a second response shape to parse for no capability we
use. What WOULD force the move: needing reasoning-item continuity across
calls, hosted tool use, or a feature OpenAI ships only on Responses.
verification_note: Verified 2026-09-23 against provider documentation and current reporting.
developers.openai.com, docs.github.com and modelparams.dev are blocked by
this environment's egress proxy, so the OpenAI facts come from search
results summarising those pages plus corroborating issue trackers, not
from a direct read of the vendor page. The Anthropic facts come from the
bundled claude-api reference, which is first-party. Availability on the
owner's own accounts is not checkable from here at all and stays a
one-time owner step. A wrong id or parameter fails LOUDLY on the first
live call -- a named API_HTTP_400 with the provider's own message
preserved under coordination/runs/ -- and never falls back silently.
